function: Learned joint mode selection, subchannel allocation and discrete transmit power control for terrestrial V2I/V2V links (p. 8: "a) power control; b) SC allocation; and c) mode selection"); STAR-RIS coefficients not learned; not one of the seven areas.
notes: Exclude, reason function. The QFRL agent's action space is p. 8: "Three aspects determine the action space of the nth EVU pair: a) power control; b) SC allocation; and c) mode selection." The optimization variables of the problem on p. 7 are mode selection, subchannel indicator and power; the STAR-RIS transmission/reflection coefficients (p. 5) are never in the action space, so no RIS configuration or beam is learned (not area 3). The links are terrestrial: p. 3 "a BS is situated at a distance far from vehicles" and "The STAR-RIS is mounted on the building", so area 6 (satellite and aerial) does not apply. Federated aggregation is digital at a server, p. 10: "Central server side processing is used for global updates" (Algorithm 2, p. 11), and the paper solves mode selection and resource allocation, not the aggregation, so not area 7. Check 4: transmit power control is a physical-layer decision learned jointly with mode selection and subchannel allocation (above the PHY), so the work passes above_phy by the joint rule and fails at function, as terrestrial power control is like link adaptation, outside the seven areas. If the reviewer reads terrestrial power control as radio resource management above the PHY, the reason becomes above_phy; the decision is exclude either way. Title on page 1 matches the DOI (p. 1: "Digital Object Identifier 10.1109/JIOT.2024.3464853").
